about: Masoretic marks profile 'minchat-shai': large, small and suspended letters, inverted nuns, the broken vav, closed and open mem, and extraordinary points as Minchat Shai records them, each quoting him at Sefaria's address. A row is disputed when he gives the mark only in some books, reports another view, or the WLC marks the same kind of mark in the verse differently; dispute.quote is his words. Words are numbered as in @metaxia/scriptures-source-openscriptures-ohb 3.0.0 (1-based, ketiv and qere as separate words); letterIndex is the 0-based index among the word's consonants (U+05D0-U+05EA). Hebrew fields (quoteHebrew, hedge, conclusion, placement, item, dispute.quote) are Minchat Shai's words, via Sefaria; every one has an English sibling (translation, hedgeTranslation, conclusionTranslation, placementTranslation, itemTranslation, dispute.translation), and every letter an English letterName. All English (translations, notes, wlcNote, dispute text) is by the package authors. In English text, Hebrew appears only as HEBREW (gloss); a gloss quoting the King James Version is marked KJV <Book> <c>:<v>: "..." (KJV numbering, verbatim from @metaxia/scriptures-source-crosswire-kjv). Sefaria has no English for these comments. The Sefaria text is snapshotted in the repository scriptures-js-source-sefaria-minchat-shai (data/sources/minchat-shai/).

source.edition: Sefaria, Hebrew; license Public Domain (every version). The five Megillot are the version 'Arba'ah Ve'Esrim im Minhat Shai. Mantua, 1742-1744' (National Library of Israel NNL_ALEPH002093602); Sefaria does not name the printed edition of the other books.

citation.conclusion: פירוש לא קטנה כשאר אותיות קטנות שבתורה רק גדולה כשאר אותיות אלא שרגלה קצר
